title: Real-Time Eye Blink Detection using Facial Landmarks
implementation_note: Introduces eye aspect ratio and temporal blink classification. Implement a time-aware blink baseline before introducing a sequence model. Map equivalent eyelid points to MediaPipe carefully; the paper's original landmark numbering is not MediaPipe numbering. This is evidence about blink detection, not a fatigue-to-score formula.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: A Realistic Dataset and Baseline Temporal Model for Early Drowsiness Detection
implementation_note: Uses sequential blink features with a hierarchical multiscale LSTM and introduces UTA-RLDD. Useful precedent for predicting from temporal behavior instead of a single face image. Reproduce a simpler baseline first. Its drowsiness benchmark does not establish accuracy for ordinary desk work or stress.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: CogBeacon: A Multi-Modal Dataset and Data-Collection Platform for Modeling Cognitive Fatigue
implementation_note: Useful precedent for coupling facial observations, self-report, and performance. Paper metadata and collection details were verified in the author repository; the publisher page was rate-limited during this review. Inspect its target definitions before attempting reproduction.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.
access_note: Author repository checked; NSF record appeared in search but returned 502 on direct fetch.

title: Evaluation of Techniques for Ocular Measurement as an Index of Fatigue and as the Basis for Alertness Management
implementation_note: Evaluates ocular measures against vigilance under controlled sleep deprivation. It motivates studying sustained closure, but does not validate a landmark threshold on an arbitrary webcam. Define closure percentage, blink exclusions, observation window, and denominator before using the name PERCLOS.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: Validation of the Karolinska Sleepiness Scale against Performance and EEG Variables
implementation_note: Supports KSS as a subjective sleepiness instrument in the studied setting. Use the specified scale, wording, timing, and version when collecting comparable labels. A homemade 0–10 slider is not KSS. Self-report remains a subjective label, not an objective diagnosis.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: NASA Task Load Index
implementation_note: Useful for a distinct task-workload experiment. Record whether the full weighted method or a documented raw version is used; preserve subscale direction and scoring. Do not rename a generic stress slider NASA-TLX, or use task workload as a sleepiness label.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.
credit_note: Institutional resource, not a paper; NASA-TLX development is associated with Sandra G. Hart and Lowell E. Staveland.

title: Validity and Sensitivity of a Brief Psychomotor Vigilance Test to Total and Partial Sleep Deprivation
implementation_note: Investigates a three-minute protocol. Useful for adding a behavioral channel beyond the camera. A 20-second click game is an engagement feature, not this validated test. Preserve stimulus timing and outcome definitions if implementing a research-oriented adaptation.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: The 3-Minute Psychomotor Vigilance Test Demonstrates Inadequate Convergent Validity Relative to the 10-Minute Psychomotor Vigilance Test Across Sleep Loss and Recovery, 2022
implementation_note: Important counterweight to P07: short and long versions are not interchangeable. Browser/device timing adds another adaptation requiring validation. Report local reaction-time observations without labeling the user impaired or unfit to drive.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: Humans Quickly Learn to Blink Strategically in Response to Environmental Task Demands, 2018
implementation_note: Shows why task context matters. Store whether a scan occurred during reading, a reaction task, conversation, or quiet viewing. Compare like with like rather than interpreting every blink-rate change as fatigue.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: Multiple Levels of Mental Attentional Demand Modulate Peak Saccade Velocity and Blink Rate, 2022
implementation_note: Useful evidence that ocular behavior varies with experimental demand. Do not transplant high-quality eye-tracker measurements such as saccade velocity into a low-frame-rate webcam without separate measurement validation.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: Algorithmic Principles of Remote PPG
implementation_note: Foundational source for the POS approach to recovering a pulse-related signal from skin-color variation. Build a signal-processing baseline before training a neural model. A pulse-rate estimate does not automatically provide reliable beat-to-beat variability or stress.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: DeepPhys: Video-Based Physiological Measurement Using Convolutional Attention Networks
implementation_note: Reference for appearance/motion representations and attention-based physiological sensing. Useful for understanding why an rPPG model needs RGB video signals, not only facial coordinates. Attention maps are not proof of causal explanation.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: Multi-Task Temporal Shift Attention Networks for On-Device Contactless Vitals Measurement, 2020
implementation_note: Reference for efficient temporal physiological sensing and an existing browser demo. This is a feasible route to an impressive optional feature, but its performance must be measured on your runtime and devices.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: rPPG-Toolbox: Deep Remote PPG Toolbox, NeurIPS 2023
implementation_note: Provides a research framework for comparing signal-processing and learned approaches with dataset loaders and evaluation. Reuse its experimental discipline rather than selecting the highest headline number from unrelated benchmarks.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.
credit_note: Authors follow the NeurIPS 2023 proceedings PDF. The arXiv record uses a different Sengupta name; cite the version actually used.

title: SCAMPS: Synthetics for Camera Measurement of Physiological Signals, 2022
implementation_note: An example of synthetic data with an explicit physiological rendering model. Useful for augmentation or pretraining research, followed by real-human evaluation. It does not justify inventing CSV fatigue labels from assumptions.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: MMPD: Multi-Domain Mobile Video Physiology Dataset, 2023
implementation_note: Useful for investigating variation in skin tone, motion, and illumination. Treat domain diversity and licensing as first-class requirements, not an afterthought to a successful single-person demo.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: UBFC-Phys: A Multimodal Database for Psychophysiological Studies of Social Stress, 2021
implementation_note: Provides video, physiology, and self-report under a social-stress protocol. Useful for a future multimodal research study. A model might learn speaking versus resting rather than stress; include task-confound checks.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: Emotional Expressions Reconsidered: Challenges to Inferring Emotion From Human Facial Movements
implementation_note: Read before naming any output “stress,” “emotion,” or “mental health.” The practical product implication is to distinguish observed movements, model estimates of defined labels, and user-reported experience.
review_scope: Primary source record, available paper text/abstract, or author documentation; no experiment replication.

title: YawDD: A Yawning Detection Dataset
implementation_note: Mouth-event dataset design; distinguish speech from yawning.
review_scope: Primary source metadata/author page checked; no experiment replication.
